coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Four of seven ground-truth variables have relevant semantic matches: statsmodels-based ACF computation, a configurable lag range bounded by T, chronological training/testing splits, and an ACF-peak lag used as a CycleNet cycle-length candidate. This yields 57%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: ETTh1 is not held constant: the design adds synthetic data and three other benchmarks. StandardScaler normalization is missing, and no ACF-versus-lag plot is specified. Instead, the design emphasizes forecasting-error plots and detector rankings. The matched variables also have deviations: cycle selection uses absolute ACF after detrending and broader performance-based criteria, while the split is independently specified as 60/20/20.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion describes an ACF plot with periodic peaks or recommends an optimal cycle length for CycleNet.
